recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a future edit reintroduces a HumanName.family array on the JSON format page.
issue_request: FHIR-13469 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction asking to fix JSON documentation examples that showed HumanName.family as a multi-value JSON array even though the STU3 definition made family singular.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 12067. Git commit b33f3e2684f438b70d073419fb52ca052e15bd9b, imported from git-svn build@12067 with subject "GF#13469 - fix json", changed source/json.html by replacing the invalid family and _family arrays with singular properties; current blame still points the relevant example lines to that commit.
additional_context: source/json.html is the active JSON format source page linked from the documentation/module navigation. Current source/datatypes/humanname.xml still defines HumanName.family as 0..1 string. A 2017 Zulip #implementers thread titled "HumanName JSON" follows the same path from bug report to GF#13469 to Grahame Grieve saying it was fixed, and Confluence searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The authoritative JSON page currently shows given as an array, family as "Van", and _family as a single object, so the reported semantic problem is already corrected.
